Stock S54 plastic plenum is NA-only — failed 9psi at Maximum PSI, and retention was the second failure mode (keeping it clamped on — e46fanatics 998597): verify any aftermarket plenum uses positive bolt-down/bracket retention, not the stock clip-style interface (open question on the CNC billet). Path B: fabricate at engine-in-car mockup using kit airbox as shape template; bundle with exhaust fab if engaged; volume >= stock airbox (Nismo 3.4->4.1L collector precedent); Jenvey APSC2-70 bespoke-base ~GBP750-990 alternative; cosmetic carbon skin +$300-800. Used-market HPF plenum = period-correct Path A alternative (HPF closed). Big-power S54 builds custom-fab or abandon ITBs. See 19b-m5x-turbo.md.
